description: Fibocom modules (USB 2cb7): the Intel XMM ones (L850-GL, L860-GL, MBIM, with profiles of their own), the Qualcomm ones (FM150, FM160, FG150, NL668; QMI or MBIM beside option) and the ECM/NCM ones. ModemManager owns them (its fibocom plugin). The FM350 is MediaTek (0e8d) with its own profiles. Reference only, not on our bench. Sources: ModemManager src/plugins/fibocom, the imported catalog (12 IDs), another modem manager modem/usb list 3.9.43; the owner, 2026-11-13
